title: Local public meetings
hook: LocalView, developed by Soubhik Barari and Tyler Simko, “is the largest dataset of local government public meetings — the central policy-making process in American local government — as they are captured on video.” In a recent paper, the authors describe how they built the dataset, which is based on 130,000+ YouTube-hosted videos of such meetings in 1,000+ US cities and counties, covering the years 2006 to 2022.
